blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque’s application for asylum has been denied, Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla claimed on Tuesday. Roque, who is reportedly in Austria seeking asylum, citing political persecution, is wanted over human trafficking charges in connection with an alleged Philippine offshore gaming operator in Pampanga.
